annotation.title_clean: Executive Summary of the Impact Assessment Report accompanying the Regulation establishing a framework of measures for strengthening Europe's cloud and AI ecosystem (Cloud and AI Development Act)
annotation.title_en: Executive Summary of the Impact Assessment Report accompanying the Regulation establishing a framework of measures for strengthening Europe's cloud and AI ecosystem (Cloud and AI Development Act)
annotation.summary_en: Commission staff executive summary of the impact assessment for the proposed Cloud and AI Development Act. It assesses six options to expand EU data centre capacity and reduce dependence on non-EU cloud and AI providers, preferring PO1-B, PO2-C and two funding measures. It concerns computing infrastructure, not robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Preferred package: PO1-B (national faster data centre deployment rules and support), PO2-C (EU-coordinated procurement and mandatory sovereign services framework), plus PM8 and PM9 funding.
Single EU-wide audit for sovereign cloud and AI services to curb 'sovereign-washing'.
Public sector federation of cloud and AI computing resources and joint procurement.
Mandatory support measures extend to NIS2 Annex I essential entities in the private sector.
Evaluation due five years after adoption.
